# Installing transfer case while transmission is mounted

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Mount the transfer case onto the vehicle with the transmission already in place. [t35]

## Tips & gotchas

- Instructions suggest removing the rear exhaust system first, but muscle and patience can make it work without full disassembly. [t35]
- This method is noted as a shortcut compared to installing the transfer case on its own. [t35]
